explanation.what: The new placement tests check line 2 and line 400 of a nine-line file, but never its boundary. Reading those assertions, changing `last <= lines.length` to `last < lines.length` would go undetected.
explanation.whatToDo: Add export cases ending on line 9 and line 10, asserting that only the former is written; also cover a file without a trailing newline.
explanation.whyHere: That regression silently drops valid misses on the final line from the replay corpus.

properties.failureScenario: Change line 363 to `last < lines.length`. A valid miss on src/user.ts line 9 is skipped as past the end of a nine-line file. The existing line-2 success and line-400 rejection still produce exactly the asserted results. This is a manually identified mutation, not a run mutant.
